summary: AB Private Credit Investors Corp, a Maryland business development company, filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its senior secured credit facility. The Second Amendment, dated August 17, 2026, increases the total facility amount from $100 million to $150 million and expands the accordion feature to permit up to $200 million in commitments. The agreement involves the fund as borrower, lenders, and The Bank of Nova Scotia as administrative and collateral agent. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation, involving no equity transaction, premium, or change of control. The filing includes standard items 1.01, 2.03, and 9.01 with the amendment as an exhibit, reflecting ordinary credit facility modification.
